penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: A managed rate-limiting component for Salesforce Experience Cloud requires Apex code deployment, org-specific configuration, and AppExchange review — all of which require per-customer technical work.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Selling into Salesforce orgs typically involves demo calls and security review conversations with admins/architects before any purchase.

rationale: The underlying pain is legitimate — guest-facing Apex REST APIs without rate limiting are a real security and cost risk on a paid enterprise platform — but the path to a solo-operated autonomous product is blocked at multiple points. An AppExchange component requires Salesforce's ISV program, security review, and Apex development; a documentation/pattern service faces stiff free competition (Salesforce Trailhead, Stack Exchange itself); and delivery in either form requires per-customer technical setup. Signal is a single forum post with no corroboration.
solution_plan: This cannot realistically be built and run autonomously by a solo non-technical operator. Publishing an AppExchange component requires ISV certification and Apex expertise. A paid documentation product competes with free official Salesforce resources. Drop this opportunity unless substantial additional signals surface and a truly automatable delivery format is identified.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy (score 5, floor 7) and buildability_with_ai (score 5, floor 6). Single signal with no corroboration.
